description: Constructed IID (phi=0) daily if-held return series -- the no-persistence control. Golden fixture pinning that a series with genuinely near-zero lag-1 autocorrelation classifies NOT_MET against a moderate positive daily Sharpe (the K&L random-walk case: no persistence means the overlay is expected-return drag).
provenance: Deterministic construction, not captured from any producer. Python: rnd = random.Random(seed=101); shocks = [rnd.uniform(-1.0, 1.0) for _ in range(55)]; phi=0 (no AR recursion -- each value is an independent draw); daily_returns_pct[t] = (0.05 * shocks[t] + 0.02) * 100. Expected rho/sharpe are computed by the test from this raw series via an independent reference formula, never hardcoded here.
